paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: Token Ratio (TR).
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the Token Ratio (TR) for three different Korean language models—RedWhale (our), EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)—across six evaluation benchmarks: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and an overall average (AVG). The horizontal axis lists the evaluation categories in left-to-right order, while the vertical axis represents the TR values, ranging from 0 to 1.00, with tick marks at regular intervals (though not explicitly labeled). Each category has three grouped bars, color-coded to represent the models: dark purple for RedWhale (our), light blue for EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and light gray for SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base). The SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) model consistently achieves a TR of 1.00 across all benchmarks, as indicated by the tallest gray bar in each group. The RedWhale model shows varying TR values: 0.42 (PT-EVAL), 0.52 (KoBEST-BQ), 0.71 (KoBEST-CP), 0.50 (KoBEST-HS), 0.69 (KoBEST-SN), and 0.57 (AVG). The EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 model exhibits TR values of 0.46 (PT-EVAL), 0.56 (KoBEST-BQ), 0.74 (KoBEST-CP), 0.54 (KoBEST-HS), 0.73 (KoBEST-SN), and 0.61 (AVG). The bars are sorted in the order of the evaluation categories, and no specific visual emphasis (e.g., bolding or shading) is applied to any bar. The chart clearly shows that SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) has the highest TR in all cases, while RedWhale and EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 have lower, variable TRs, with EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 generally outperforming RedWhale in each benchmark.
